review_notes: I read the whole file. Its only new concept is `kroneckerJordanRep`, a Jordan block placed on both vertices of the generalized Kronecker quiver. It is built on `kroneckerRep`, which is defined in another TauCeti file and is not a competitor. The file reuses Mathlib's `AdjoinRoot`, `LinearMap.mulLeft` and `LinearMap.mulRight`, `ModuleCat`, `IsZero`, and `CategoryTheory.Indecomposable`. A grep of Mathlib found `Indecomposable` only in the BinaryBiproducts file, and the file does not redefine it. Mathlib has no quiver-representation Jordan block or Kronecker finite-representation-type notion that this file duplicates. A grep of Mathlib for `IsFiniteRepType` found nothing, and its only definition is in TauCeti's FiniteRepType/Basic.lean. The private `jordanApp` and the `jordanApp_*` lemmas are local projections of an endomorphism to its source-vertex component, not a competing public concept. I found no concrete duplicated substantive API, so I am reporting nothing. I did not read the sibling TauCeti files (`Kronecker.Representation`, the OneLoop analogue) in full, so a duplication across those files is possible but is outside this target file.
